description: Plinacro - Optičko - komunikacijski sustav is a dataset listed in NIPP Geoportal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ipp.plinacro.hr. The spatial data base contains vector, spatial data and attribute, descriptive data on objects of the optical-communication system under the jurisdiction of Plinacro. Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Plinacro - Optical - communication system" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspiregeoportal. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
